functions.name: account_asset_root_claims
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.account_asset_root_claims()
 RETURNS TABLE(account_id uuid, asset_root text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH deployment AS (SELECT local_identity.media_deployment() value),
 globals AS (SELECT rtrim(value->>'targetRoot','/') root FROM deployment
  UNION SELECT rtrim(jsonb_array_elements_text(value->'sourceRoots'),'/') FROM deployment),
 roots AS (
  SELECT account_id,rtrim(asset_root,'/') root FROM local_identity.episode_asset_locations
  UNION SELECT account_id,rtrim(policy->>'asset_root','/') FROM public.account_blueprint_versions WHERE coalesce(policy->>'asset_root','')<>''
  UNION SELECT account_id,rtrim(source_root,'/') FROM local_identity.account_directory_locations
  UNION SELECT account_id,rtrim(actual_root,'/') FROM local_identity.account_directory_locations
 )
 SELECT d.account_id,d.actual_root FROM local_identity.account_asset_directories d WHERE session_user IN ('loop_app','loop_worker')
 UNION SELECT r.account_id,r.root FROM roots r WHERE session_user IN ('loop_app','loop_worker') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM globals g WHERE g.root=r.root)
 UNION SELECT r.account_id,r.root||'/'||coalesce(l.directory_relative_path,'episodes/'||e.id::text)
  FROM roots r JOIN public.episodes e ON e.account_id=r.account_id
  LEFT JOIN local_identity.episode_asset_locations l ON l.episode_id=e.id
  WHERE session_user IN ('loop_app','loop_worker') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM globals g WHERE g.root=r.root)
 UNION SELECT m.account_id,m.manifest->>'targetRoot' FROM local_identity.account_directory_migrations m
  WHERE session_user IN ('loop_app','loop_worker') AND m.status IN ('planned','copying','failed')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.account_directory_has_references(p_paths text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF session_user<>'loop_app' OR local_identity.owner_id() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Owner session required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 IF cardinality(p_paths) IS NULL OR cardinality(p_paths)=0 OR cardinality(p_paths)>256 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p_paths) p WHERE p IS NULL OR left(p,1)<>'/' OR p='/') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid account directory paths' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.account_asset_root_claims() r CROSS JOIN unnest(p_paths) p WHERE rtrim(r.asset_root,'/')=p OR left(rtrim(r.asset_root,'/'),length(p)+1)=p||'/' OR left(p,length(rtrim(r.asset_root,'/'))+1)=rtrim(r.asset_root,'/')||'/');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.confirm_caption_text(p_episode_id uuid, p_review_package_id uuid, p_shot_id text, p_audio_track_id uuid, p_audio_sha256 text, p_text_fingerprint text, p_alignment_input_version text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE d public.shot_preparation_drafts; a public.audio_tracks; reviewer uuid:=local_identity.owner_id(); BEGIN
 IF local_identity.actor_role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR NOT local_identity.lock_owned_input_episode(p_episode_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Owner input Episode required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.episodes e JOIN local_identity.input_episodes i ON i.episode_id=e.id WHERE e.id=p_episode_id AND i.storyboard_enabled AND (e.stage IN ('storyboard_approved','production_ready','render_ready','qc_review') OR local_identity.workspace_shot_context(p_episode_id,p_review_package_id,p_shot_id) IS NOT NULL)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current editable storyboard required' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
 SELECT s.* INTO d FROM public.shot_preparation_drafts s JOIN public.review_packages r ON r.id=s.review_package_id
 WHERE s.episode_id=p_episode_id AND s.review_package_id=p_review_package_id AND s.shot_id=p_shot_id
  AND r.stage='storyboard_review' AND r.invalidated_at IS NULL
  AND r.id=(SELECT id FROM public.review_packages WHERE episode_id=p_episode_id AND stage='storyboard_review' AND invalidated_at IS NULL ORDER BY revision_number DESC LIMIT 1)
 FOR UPDATE OF s;
 SELECT * INTO a FROM public.audio_tracks WHERE id=d.current_audio_track_id AND episode_id=p_episode_id;
 IF d.id IS NULL OR a.id IS NULL OR d.audio_mode='none' OR NOT d.subtitles_enabled OR btrim(d.subtitle_text)=''
  OR d.current_audio_track_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_audio_track_id OR a.sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM p_audio_sha256
  OR encode(extensions.digest(d.subtitle_text,'sha256'),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM p_text_fingerprint
  OR d.acoustic_alignment->>'inputVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM p_alignment_input_version
  OR d.acoustic_alignment->>'textFingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM p_text_fingerprint
  OR d.acoustic_alignment->>'audioSha256' IS DISTINCT FROM p_audio_sha256
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Caption text review identity changed' USING ERRCODE='40001'; END IF;
 UPDATE public.shot_preparation_drafts SET caption_text_confirmation=jsonb_build_object(
  'version','caption-text-confirmation/v1','audioTrackId',a.id,'audioSha256',a.sha256,
  'textFingerprint',p_text_fingerprint,'alignmentInputVersion',p_alignment_input_version,
  'confirmedText',d.subtitle_text,'confirmedBy',reviewer,'confirmedAt',clock_timestamp()),updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE id=d.id;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('saved',true);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.episode_completed_storage_lineage(p_episode uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF local_identity.episode_storage_lineage
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT l.* FROM local_identity.episode_storage_lineage l
 JOIN local_identity.storage_location_operations o ON o.id=l.operation_id
 LEFT JOIN local_identity.account_directory_migrations m ON m.id=o.migration_id
 LEFT JOIN local_identity.media_root_migrations g ON g.id=o.media_root_migration_id JOIN public.episodes e ON e.id=l.episode_id AND e.account_id=l.account_id
 WHERE l.episode_id=p_episode AND o.proof_sha256=encode(sha256(convert_to(o.proof::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
 AND ((o.kind='root_migration' AND g.status IN ('committed','completed') AND o.proof=g.publication AND g.manifest_sha256=encode(sha256(convert_to(g.manifest::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AND o.proof->>'manifestSha256'=g.manifest_sha256 AND o.proof->>'planId'=g.id::text
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(g.manifest->'episodes') ep JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(g.manifest->'directories') d ON d->>'episodeId'=ep->>'id' AND d->>'kind'='episode' WHERE ep->>'id'=l.episode_id::text AND ep->>'accountId'=l.account_id::text AND (ep->'location'->>'assetRoot',ep->'location'->>'relativePath',d->'source'->>'device',d->'source'->>'inode')=(l.source_root,l.source_prefix,l.source_device_id,l.source_inode_id))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.proof->'bindings') b WHERE b->>'episodeId'=l.episode_id::text AND b->>'accountId'=l.account_id::text AND (b->>'sourceRoot',b->>'sourcePrefix',b->>'sourceDeviceId',b->>'sourceInodeId',b->>'actualRoot',b->>'relativePath',b->>'deviceId',b->>'inodeId')=(l.source_root,l.source_prefix,l.source_device_id,l.source_inode_id,l.target_root,l.target_prefix,l.target_device_id,l.target_inode_id))) OR (o.kind='restore' AND o.proof->>'archiveSha256'=o.archive_sha256
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.proof->'bindings') b WHERE b->>'episodeId'=l.episode_id::text AND b->>'accountId'=l.account_id::text
   AND (b->>'sourceRoot',b->>'relativePath',b->>'sourceDeviceId',b->>'sourceInodeId',b->>'actualRoot',b->>'relativePath',b->>'deviceId',b->>'inodeId')=(l.source_root,l.source_prefix,l.source_device_id,l.source_inode_id,l.target_root,l.target_prefix,l.target_device_id,l.target_inode_id)))
 OR (m.status='completed' AND o.proof=m.manifest AND m.account_id=l.account_id AND m.manifest->>'targetRoot'=l.target_root
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.manifest->'episodes') ep CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(ep->'sources') s
   WHERE ep->>'id'=l.episode_id::text AND ep->>'targetPrefix'=l.target_prefix AND (s->'root'->>'path',s->>'prefix',s->'directory'->>'device',s->'directory'->>'inode')=(l.source_root,l.source_prefix,l.source_device_id,l.source_inode_id))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.manifest->'createdDirectories') d WHERE (d->>'path',d->>'device',d->>'inode')=(l.target_root||'/'||l.target_prefix,l.target_device_id,l.target_inode_id))))
 AND (session_user IN ('postgres','loop_worker') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_memberships a WHERE a.account_id=l.account_id AND a.user_id=local_identity.owner_id() AND a.role='owner')) ORDER BY l.id
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.episode_current_reference(p_episode uuid, p_reference text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH RECURSIVE current AS(SELECT *,local_identity.storage_physical_root(asset_root) root FROM local_identity.episode_storage_location(p_episode)),
 edges AS(SELECT * FROM local_identity.episode_completed_storage_lineage(p_episode)),
 walk(root,prefix,device,inode,suffix) AS(
  SELECT source_root,source_prefix,source_device_id,source_inode_id,substring(p_reference from length(source_prefix)+2)
   FROM edges WHERE left(p_reference,length(source_prefix)+1)=source_prefix||'/'
  UNION
  SELECT e.target_root,e.target_prefix,e.target_device_id,e.target_inode_id,w.suffix FROM walk w JOIN edges e
   ON (w.root,w.prefix,w.device,w.inode)=(e.source_root,e.source_prefix,e.source_device_id,e.source_inode_id)
 ), matches AS(SELECT c.directory_relative_path||'/'||w.suffix path FROM walk w CROSS JOIN current c
   WHERE (w.root,w.prefix,w.device,w.inode)=(c.root,c.directory_relative_path,c.directory_device_id,c.directory_inode_id))
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_reference ~ '(^/|\\|(^|/)\.{1,2}(/|$)|//|/$)' THEN NULL
 WHEN left(p_reference,length(c.directory_relative_path)+1)=c.directory_relative_path||'/' THEN p_reference
 ELSE (SELECT min(path) FROM matches HAVING count(DISTINCT path)=1) END FROM current c
$function$

AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tasks t WHERE t.id=p_task_id AND t.input_snapshot#>>'{production_selection,capability}'='video') THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM local_identity.input_media_connection_before_video_selection(p_task_id,p_attempt,p_lease_token,p_version_id);RETURN;END IF;
 IF local_identity.actor_role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Worker required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 PERFORM public.refresh_worker_task_lease(p_task_id,p_attempt,p_lease_token);
 RETURN QUERY SELECT cv.id,cv.provider,cv.adapter,cv.endpoint,b.secret_ref FROM public.tasks t
 JOIN local_identity.input_episodes i ON i.episode_id=t.episode_id AND i.enabled AND i.media_enabled
 JOIN public.external_connection_versions cv ON cv.id=p_version_id AND cv.provider=t.provider AND cv.adapter=t.input_snapshot#>>'{executor,adapter}' AND cv.revoked_at IS NULL
 JOIN public.external_connections cn ON cn.id=cv.connection_id AND cn.created_by=i.owner_id
 JOIN local_identity.connection_bindings b ON b.version_id=cv.id AND b.owner_id=i.owner_id AND b.store_mode='keychain'
 JOIN local_identity.connection_qualifications q ON q.version_id=cv.id AND q.owner_id=i.owner_id AND q.qualified
 WHERE t.id=p_task_id AND t.input_snapshot->>'credential_ref'=cv.id::text AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.connection_probe_evidence pe WHERE pe.version_id=cv.id AND pe.owner_id=i.owner_id AND pe.mode='live' AND pe.outcome='verified');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.prevent_pending_publication_retry()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- This trigger runs under the task row lock, including when a failure report
 -- started before the publication fence committed and waited for that lock.
 IF NEW.status IN ('ready','failed','blocked') AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.native_output_publications WHERE task_id=NEW.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Native output publication requires explicit reconciliation before retry' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.provider_dispatch_context_current(p_task uuid, p_kind text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.tasks t JOIN public.episodes e ON e.id=t.episode_id
  JOIN local_identity.production_workspaces w ON w.episode_id=e.id
  JOIN local_identity.production_preparation_revisions p ON p.id=w.preparation_revision_id AND p.episode_id=e.id AND p.script_revision_id=w.script_revision_id
  WHERE t.id=p_task AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND e.archived_at IS NULL
   AND e.stage<>'production_completed' AND NOT local_identity.is_recycled_episode(e.id)
   AND e.main_script_revision_id=w.script_revision_id AND local_identity.preparation_source_current(p.id)
   AND CASE WHEN p_kind='speech' THEN
    t.task_type='generate_narration' AND EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.workspace_narration_requests r
     JOIN local_identity.workspace_production_authorizations a ON a.episode_id=r.episode_id
     WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.workspace_id=w.id AND a.enabled AND a.authorized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND a.script_revision_id=w.script_revision_id AND a.authorization_hash=r.authorization_hash
      AND CASE WHEN t.input_snapshot ? 'workspace_narration' THEN
       t.input_snapshot#>>'{workspace_narration,version}'='workspace-narration/v2'
       AND t.input_snapshot#>>'{workspace_narration,workspace_id}'=w.id::text
       AND t.input_snapshot#>>'{workspace_narration,shot_id}'=r.shot_id
       AND t.input_snapshot#>>'{workspace_narration,preparation_revision_id}'=p.id::text
       AND r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,preparationRevisionId}'=p.id::text
       AND r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,workspaceId}'=w.id::text
       AND r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,shotId}'=r.shot_id
       AND r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,scriptRevisionId}'=w.script_revision_id::text
      ELSE p.source_format='storyboard/v1'
       AND t.input_snapshot->>'storyboard_review_package_id'=p.source_reference_id::text
      END
      AND CASE WHEN r.request_snapshot->>'selectionVersion'='1'
       THEN w.project_sha256=r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,projectSha256}'
       ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.workspace_narrations n WHERE n.workspace_id=w.id AND n.shot_id=r.shot_id AND n.mode='tts' AND n.task_id=t.id AND n.input_fingerprint=r.input_fingerprint AND n.confirmed_fingerprint=r.input_fingerprint) END)
   ELSE p_kind='image' AND t.task_type='generate_static_visual' AND t.provider='openai'
    AND local_identity.workspace_task_preparation_current(t.id,w.id) AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.workspace_visual_candidates v
    JOIN local_identity.workspace_production_authorizations a ON a.episode_id=v.episode_id
    WHERE v.task_id=t.id AND v.workspace_id=w.id AND a.enabled AND a.authorized_at IS NOT NULL
     AND a.script_revision_id=w.script_revision_id AND a.authorization_hash=v.request_snapshot->>'authorizationHash'
     AND (v.request_snapshot#>>'{target,projectSha256}' IS NULL OR w.project_sha256=v.request_snapshot#>>'{target,projectSha256}')
     AND (NOT(t.input_snapshot ? 'production_preparation') OR v.request_snapshot#>>'{target,workspaceId}'=w.id::text AND v.request_snapshot#>>'{target,preparationRevisionId}'=w.preparation_revision_id::text AND v.request_snapshot#>>'{target,shotId}'=v.shot_id AND v.request_snapshot#>>'{target,scriptRevisionId}'=w.script_revision_id::text)) END
 )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.save_production_narration_input(p_workspace uuid, p_shot text, p_mode text, p_text text, p_voice text, p_rate numeric, p_language text, p_audio uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE w local_identity.production_workspaces;
BEGIN
 w:=local_identity.lock_current_production_workspace(p_workspace);
 IF p_mode IS NULL OR p_mode NOT IN ('tts','manual','none') OR p_text IS NULL OR length(p_text)>100000
  OR p_voice IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(p_voice)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200
  OR p_rate IS NOT NULL AND p_rate NOT BETWEEN 0.5 AND 2
  OR p_mode='tts' AND (btrim(p_text)='' OR p_voice IS NULL OR p_rate IS NULL OR coalesce(btrim(p_language),'')='' OR length(p_language)>30)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.bindings) b WHERE b->>'shotId'=p_shot) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Valid current narration input required' USING ERRCODE='22023';
 END IF;
 IF p_mode='manual' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.audio_tracks a WHERE a.id=p_audio AND a.episode_id=w.episode_id AND a.track_kind='narration')
  OR p_mode<>'manual' AND p_audio IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Owned registered narration track required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 INSERT INTO local_identity.workspace_narration_inputs(workspace_id,episode_id,preparation_revision_id,shot_id,mode,narration_text,voice,speaking_rate,language_code,voice_override,audio_track_id)
 VALUES(w.id,w.episode_id,w.preparation_revision_id,p_shot,p_mode,p_text,p_voice,p_rate,p_language,p_mode='tts' AND p_voice IS NOT NULL,p_audio)
 ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,preparation_revision_id,shot_id) DO UPDATE SET mode=excluded.mode,narration_text=excluded.narration_text,voice=excluded.voice,speaking_rate=excluded.speaking_rate,language_code=excluded.language_code,voice_override=excluded.voice_override,audio_track_id=excluded.audio_track_id,updated_at=clock_timestamp();
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.save_script_shot_gains(p_episode uuid, p_review uuid, p_shot text, p_voice numeric, p_bgm numeric, p_sfx numeric)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF NOT local_identity.lock_owned_input_episode(p_episode) OR p_voice IS NULL OR p_bgm IS NULL OR p_sfx IS NULL
 OR p_voice NOT BETWEEN -60 AND 12 OR p_bgm NOT BETWEEN -60 AND 12 OR p_sfx NOT BETWEEN -60 AND 12
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.episodes e JOIN public.review_packages r ON r.episode_id=e.id
 WHERE e.id=p_episode AND e.stage IN ('storyboard_approved','production_ready','render_ready','qc_review') AND r.id=p_review AND r.invalidated_at IS NULL AND r.stage='storyboard_review'
 AND r.revision_number=(SELECT max(revision_number) FROM public.review_packages WHERE episode_id=p_episode AND stage='storyboard_review' AND invalidated_at IS NULL)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.approvals a WHERE a.review_package_id=r.id AND a.stage='storyboard_approved' AND a.decision='approved')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid owned shot mix' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 UPDATE public.shot_preparation_drafts SET script_narration_gain_db=p_voice,script_bgm_gain_db=p_bgm,script_sfx_gain_db=p_sfx
 WHERE episode_id=p_episode AND review_package_id=p_review AND shot_id=p_shot;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Shot preparation required'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.storage_physical_root(p_root text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH input AS(SELECT rtrim(p_root,'/') root),d AS(SELECT local_identity.media_deployment() value), a AS(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(value->'sourceRoots') root FROM d)
 SELECT CASE WHEN input.root=d.value->>'targetRoot' OR left(input.root,length(d.value->>'targetRoot')+1)=(d.value->>'targetRoot')||'/' THEN input.root
 ELSE coalesce((SELECT (d.value->>'targetRoot')||substring(input.root from length(a.root)+1) FROM a WHERE input.root=a.root OR left(input.root,length(a.root)+1)=a.root||'/' ORDER BY length(a.root) DESC LIMIT 1),input.root) END FROM d CROSS JOIN input
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.sync_workspace_caption_inputs(p_workspace uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE w local_identity.production_workspaces; p local_identity.production_preparation_revisions;
BEGIN
 w:=local_identity.lock_current_production_workspace(p_workspace);
 SELECT * INTO p FROM local_identity.production_preparation_revisions WHERE id=w.preparation_revision_id;
 -- Formatting-only children inherit editable inputs without relabeling or rewriting their parent.
 INSERT INTO local_identity.workspace_caption_inputs(workspace_id,episode_id,preparation_revision_id,shot_id,contract,imported_from_draft_id,imported_from_package_id)
  SELECT w.id,w.episode_id,p.id,i.shot_id,i.contract,i.imported_from_draft_id,i.imported_from_package_id
  FROM local_identity.workspace_caption_inputs i JOIN local_identity.production_shot_versions s ON s.preparation_revision_id=p.id AND s.shot_id=i.shot_id
  WHERE i.workspace_id=w.id AND i.preparation_revision_id=p.parent_preparation_revision_id
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 IF p.source_format='storyboard/v1' THEN
  INSERT INTO local_identity.workspace_caption_inputs(workspace_id,episode_id,preparation_revision_id,shot_id,contract,imported_from_draft_id,imported_from_package_id,created_at,updated_at)
   SELECT w.id,w.episode_id,p.id,d.shot_id,d.caption_contract,d.id,d.review_package_id,d.created_at,d.updated_at
   FROM public.shot_preparation_drafts d JOIN local_identity.production_shot_versions s ON s.preparation_revision_id=p.id AND s.shot_id=d.shot_id
   WHERE d.episode_id=w.episode_id AND d.review_package_id=p.source_reference_id
   ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.workspace_shot_context(p_episode uuid, p_review uuid, p_shot text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT s.snapshot||jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('id',s.shot_id,'scriptSegment',CASE WHEN s.origin='local' THEN coalesce(
  (SELECT d.narration_text FROM local_identity.workspace_narration_inputs d WHERE d.workspace_id=w.id AND d.preparation_revision_id=p.id AND d.shot_id=s.shot_id),
  (SELECT b->>'text' FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.bindings) b WHERE b->>'shotId'=s.shot_id LIMIT 1),'') ELSE s.baseline_text END,
  'shotType',local_identity.historical_preparation_shot_classification(p.id,s.shot_id)))
 FROM local_identity.production_shot_versions s JOIN local_identity.production_workspaces w ON w.preparation_revision_id=s.preparation_revision_id AND w.episode_id=s.episode_id
 JOIN public.episodes e ON e.id=w.episode_id JOIN local_identity.production_preparation_revisions p ON p.id=w.preparation_revision_id AND p.script_revision_id=w.script_revision_id
 WHERE w.episode_id=p_episode AND p.id=p_review AND s.shot_id=p_shot AND e.main_script_revision_id=w.script_revision_id
  AND local_identity.preparation_source_current(p.id) AND e.archived_at IS NULL AND e.stage<>'production_completed' AND NOT local_identity.is_historical_episode(e.id) AND NOT local_identity.is_recycled_episode(e.id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION local_identity.workspace_task_preparation_current(p_task uuid, p_workspace uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tasks t JOIN local_identity.production_workspaces w ON w.episode_id=t.episode_id
 JOIN public.episodes e ON e.id=w.episode_id JOIN local_identity.production_preparation_revisions p ON p.id=w.preparation_revision_id AND p.episode_id=e.id AND p.script_revision_id=w.script_revision_id
 WHERE t.id=p_task AND w.id=p_workspace AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND e.main_script_revision_id=w.script_revision_id
  AND e.archived_at IS NULL AND e.stage<>'production_completed' AND NOT local_identity.is_recycled_episode(e.id) AND NOT local_identity.is_historical_episode(e.id)
  AND local_identity.preparation_source_current(p.id)
  AND CASE WHEN t.input_snapshot ? 'production_preparation' THEN
   t.input_snapshot#>>'{production_preparation,version}'='production-preparation-ref/v1'
   AND t.input_snapshot#>>'{production_preparation,workspace_id}'=w.id::text
   AND t.input_snapshot#>>'{production_preparation,preparation_revision_id}'=p.id::text
   AND t.input_snapshot#>>'{production_preparation,script_revision_id}'=w.script_revision_id::text
   AND (NOT(t.input_snapshot->'production_preparation' ? 'shot_id') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.production_shot_versions shot WHERE shot.preparation_revision_id=p.id AND shot.episode_id=e.id AND shot.shot_id=t.input_snapshot#>>'{production_preparation,shot_id}'))
   AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.workspace_visual_candidates v
    WHERE v.task_id=t.id AND v.workspace_id=w.id AND v.episode_id=e.id AND v.shot_id IS NOT NULL
     AND v.shot_id=t.input_snapshot#>>'{production_preparation,shot_id}'
     AND v.id::text=coalesce(t.input_snapshot->>'workspace_image_request_id',t.input_snapshot->>'workspace_visual_request_id')
     AND (v.request_snapshot->>'kind'='image' AND t.task_type='generate_static_visual' OR v.request_snapshot->>'kind'='video' AND t.task_type IN ('generate_shot_video','generate_a_roll','generate_b_roll')))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.workspace_audio_requests r JOIN local_identity.workspace_audio_preparations a ON a.id=r.preparation_id
     WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.workspace_id=w.id AND r.episode_id=e.id AND a.workspace_id=w.id AND a.episode_id=e.id
      AND t.task_type IN ('extract_embedded_audio','generate_soundtrack')
      AND a.shot_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.input_snapshot#>>'{production_preparation,shot_id}' AND (a.kind<>'source' OR a.shot_id IS NOT NULL))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.workspace_pexels_requests r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.workspace_id=w.id AND r.episode_id=e.id
     AND t.provider='pexels' AND t.task_type IN ('search_shot_video','preview_shot_video') AND r.id::text=t.input_snapshot->>'workspace_pexels_request_id' AND t.prompt_version='workspace-pexels-v1' AND t.model='pexels-video-v1'
     AND t.input_snapshot->'workspace_target'=r.request_snapshot->'target'
     AND coalesce(t.input_snapshot#>>'{media,video,request,operation}',t.input_snapshot#>>'{media,b_roll,request,operation}')=r.request_snapshot->>'operation'
     AND CASE WHEN t.task_type='generate_b_roll' THEN r.request_snapshot->>'operation' IN ('search','preview') ELSE t.task_type=CASE r.request_snapshot->>'operation' WHEN 'search' THEN 'search_shot_video' WHEN 'preview' THEN 'preview_shot_video' END END
     AND r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,workspaceId}'=w.id::text AND r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,preparationRevisionId}'=p.id::text
     AND r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,scriptRevisionId}'=w.script_revision_id::text AND r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,shotId}'=t.input_snapshot#>>'{production_preparation,shot_id}'
     AND r.target_item_id=r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,targetItemId}'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.bindings) b WHERE b->>'itemId'=r.target_item_id AND b->>'shotId'=r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,shotId}')))
  ELSE p.source_format='storyboard/v1' AND p.source_reference_id=w.storyboard_package_id
   AND (t.provider IS DISTINCT FROM 'pexels' AND (t.input_snapshot->>'storyboard_review_package_id'=p.source_reference_id::text OR t.task_type='generate_static_visual'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.workspace_visual_candidates v WHERE v.workspace_id=w.id AND v.episode_id=e.id AND v.task_id=t.id AND v.id::text=t.input_snapshot->>'workspace_image_request_id'))
    OR t.provider='pexels' AND t.task_type IN ('search_shot_video','preview_shot_video','generate_b_roll')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM local_identity.workspace_pexels_requests r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.workspace_id=w.id AND r.episode_id=e.id
     AND NOT(r.request_snapshot->'target' ? 'preparationRevisionId') AND NOT(r.request_snapshot->'target' ? 'workspaceId')
     AND r.id::text=t.input_snapshot->>'workspace_pexels_request_id' AND t.prompt_version='workspace-pexels-v1' AND t.model='pexels-video-v1'
     AND t.input_snapshot->'workspace_target'=r.request_snapshot->'target'
     AND coalesce(t.input_snapshot#>>'{media,video,request,operation}',t.input_snapshot#>>'{media,b_roll,request,operation}')=r.request_snapshot->>'operation'
     AND CASE WHEN t.task_type='generate_b_roll' THEN r.request_snapshot->>'operation' IN ('search','preview') ELSE t.task_type=CASE r.request_snapshot->>'operation' WHEN 'search' THEN 'search_shot_video' WHEN 'preview' THEN 'preview_shot_video' END END AND r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,scriptRevisionId}'=w.script_revision_id::text
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.bindings) b WHERE b->>'itemId'=r.target_item_id AND b->>'shotId'=r.request_snapshot#>>'{target,shotId}')))
  END)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assert_current_storyboard_shot(p_episode_id uuid, p_review_package_id uuid, p_shot_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  selected_package public.review_packages;
  selected_shot jsonb;
begin
  select package.* into selected_package
  from public.review_packages package
  join lateral (select 1 where local_identity.workspace_shot_context(p_episode_id,p_review_package_id,p_shot_id) IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(select 1 from public.approvals approval where approval.review_package_id=package.id and approval.stage='storyboard_approved' and approval.decision='approved')) approval on true
  where package.id = p_review_package_id
    and package.episode_id = p_episode_id
    and package.stage = 'storyboard_review'
    and package.invalidated_at is null
  for update of package;
  if not found then raise exception 'The approved storyboard review package is required' using errcode = '22023'; end if;

  select shot.value into selected_shot
  from jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN local_identity.workspace_shot_context(p_episode_id,p_review_package_id,p_shot_id) IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_array(local_identity.workspace_shot_context(p_episode_id,p_review_package_id,p_shot_id)) ELSE coalesce(selected_package.context_snapshot #> '{worker_result,storyboard,shots}', '[]'::jsonb) END) shot(value)
  where shot.value ->> 'id' = btrim(p_shot_id);
  if not found then raise exception 'The shot does not belong to the approved storyboard' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare selected public.tasks;
begin
  if local_identity.actor_role() is distinct from 'service_role' then raise exception 'Worker service role is required' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  select * into selected from public.tasks where id=p_task_id for update;
  if not found or selected.status <> 'running' or selected.attempt <> p_attempt+1
    or p_lease_token is null or selected.lease_token is distinct from p_lease_token
    or selected.claimed_at is null or selected.claimed_at <= clock_timestamp()-interval '30 minutes'
    or not exists(select 1 from public.task_runs where task_id=p_task_id and attempt=p_attempt and status='running' and lease_token=p_lease_token)
    then raise exception 'Worker lease is expired or belongs to another attempt' using errcode='42501'; end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.build_shot_audio_mix_before_script_v2(p_draft public.shot_preparation_drafts)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  bgm public.storyboard_audio_selections;
  sfx public.storyboard_audio_selections;
  effective_ducking text;
  duck_depth numeric;
begin
  select selection.* into bgm
  from public.storyboard_audio_selections selection
  where selection.episode_id = p_draft.episode_id
    and selection.review_package_id = p_draft.review_package_id
    and selection.target_kind = 'episode'
    and selection.target_id = p_draft.episode_id::text
    and selection.audio_kind = 'bgm'
    and (selection.cue_id is not null or selection.material_revision_id is not null);

  select selection.* into sfx
  from public.storyboard_audio_selections selection
  where selection.episode_id = p_draft.episode_id
    and selection.review_package_id = p_draft.review_package_id
    and selection.target_kind = 'shot'
    and selection.target_id = p_draft.shot_id
    and selection.audio_kind = 'sfx'
    and (selection.cue_id is not null or selection.material_revision_id is not null);

  effective_ducking := case when bgm.id is null or p_draft.audio_mode = 'none' then 'off' else p_draft.bgm_ducking_level end;
  duck_depth := case effective_ducking when 'light' then -6 when 'medium' then -10 when 'strong' then -14 else 0 end;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'version', 'shot-audio-mix/v1',
    'main_voice', jsonb_build_object(
      'mode', p_draft.audio_mode,
      'track_id', case when p_draft.audio_mode = 'none' then null else p_draft.current_audio_track_id end,
      'gain_db', 0,
      'role', case when p_draft.audio_mode = 'none' then 'none' else 'anchor' end
    ),
    'bgm', case when bgm.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
      'selection_id', bgm.id,
      'cue_id', bgm.cue_id,
      'material_revision_id', bgm.material_revision_id,
      'gain_db', -12,
      'role', 'follower',
      'ducking_level', effective_ducking,
      'duck_depth_db', duck_depth
    ) end,
    'sfx', case when sfx.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
      'selection_id', sfx.id,
      'cue_id', sfx.cue_id,
      'material_revision_id', sfx.material_revision_id,
      'gain_db', -6,
      'role', 'independent',
      'automatic_ducking', false
    ) end
  );
end;
$function$

    'episode', jsonb_build_object('id', selected_episode.id, 'account_id', selected_episode.account_id, 'blueprint_version_id', selected_episode.blueprint_version_id, 'title', selected_episode.title),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_current_shot_preparation_snapshot(p_episode_id uuid, p_storyboard_review_package_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with storyboard as (
  select package.context_snapshot #> '{worker_result,storyboard,shots}' as shots
  from public.review_packages package
  where package.id = p_storyboard_review_package_id and package.episode_id = p_episode_id
    and package.stage = 'storyboard_review' and package.invalidated_at is null
), required_shots as (
  select shot.value from storyboard cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(storyboard.shots, '[]'::jsonb)) shot(value)
), valid_shots as (
  select required.value
  from required_shots required
  join public.shot_preparation_drafts draft on draft.episode_id = p_episode_id
    and draft.review_package_id = p_storyboard_review_package_id and draft.shot_id = required.value ->> 'id'
  join public.production_material_revisions material on material.id = draft.selected_material_revision_id
    and material.episode_id = p_episode_id and material.material_type = 'video'
  join public.material_revision_approvals approval on approval.material_revision_id = material.id
  where draft.input_fingerprint = md5(required.value::text) and draft.preparation_contract_status = 'current' and draft.preparation_contract is not null and draft.preparation_input_fingerprint = draft.preparation_contract ->> 'input_fingerprint' and (not draft.subtitles_enabled or coalesce(btrim(draft.subtitle_text), '') <> '')
    and jsonb_typeof(draft.clip_segments) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(draft.clip_segments) > 0
    and not exists (
      select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(draft.clip_segments) segment
      where jsonb_typeof(segment) <> 'object'
        or jsonb_typeof(segment -> 'start_seconds') <> 'number'
        or jsonb_typeof(segment -> 'end_seconds') <> 'number'
        or (segment ->> 'start_seconds')::numeric < 0
        or (segment ->> 'end_seconds')::numeric <= (segment ->> 'start_seconds')::numeric
    )
    and (draft.audio_mode <> 'tts' or exists (
      select 1 from public.audio_tracks track join public.tasks task on task.id = track.source_task_id
      where track.id = draft.current_audio_track_id and track.episode_id = p_episode_id
        and track.cue_id = draft.shot_id and track.source_review_package_id = p_storyboard_review_package_id
        and track.track_kind = 'narration' and track.sha256 is not null and track.file_size > 0
        and task.status = 'completed' and task.invalidated_at is null
        and task.input_snapshot #>> '{media,narration,text}' = draft.tts_text
        and task.input_snapshot ->> 'configuration_hash' = public.shot_tts_configuration_hash(p_episode_id, draft.id)
    ))
)
select exists (select 1 from storyboard where jsonb_typeof(storyboard.shots) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(storyboard.shots) > 0)
  and (select count(*) from valid_shots) = (select count(*) from required_shots);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_required_artifacts(p_episode_id uuid, p_to_stage public.episode_stage)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case p_to_stage
    when 'script_approved' then exists (
      select 1 from public.artifacts where episode_id = p_episode_id and artifact_type = 'script'
    )
    when 'visual_approved' then exists (
      select 1 from public.artifacts where episode_id = p_episode_id and artifact_type in ('visual_brief', 'visual_asset_manifest')
    )
    when 'storyboard_approved' then exists (
      select 1 from public.artifacts where episode_id = p_episode_id and artifact_type = 'storyboard'
    )
    when 'production_ready' then exists (
      select 1
      from public.review_packages package
      where package.episode_id = p_episode_id
        and package.stage = 'production_ready'
        and package.invalidated_at is null
        and (
          package.context_snapshot ->> 'confirmation_mode' is distinct from 'shot_preparation'
          or public.has_current_shot_preparation_snapshot(
            p_episode_id,
            (package.context_snapshot ->> 'storyboard_review_package_id')::uuid
          )
        )
    )
    when 'render_ready' then exists (
      select 1
      from public.review_packages package
      where package.episode_id = p_episode_id
        and package.stage = 'production_ready'
        and package.invalidated_at is null
        and (
          package.context_snapshot ->> 'confirmation_mode' is distinct from 'shot_preparation'
          or public.has_current_shot_preparation_snapshot(
            p_episode_id,
            (package.context_snapshot ->> 'storyboard_review_package_id')::uuid
          )
        )
        and (
          package.context_snapshot ->> 'approval_mode' = 'qc_only'
          or not exists (
            select 1
            from public.pre_render_review_members member
            where member.review_package_id = package.id
              and not exists (
                select 1
                from public.pre_render_review_member_decisions decision
                where decision.review_package_id = member.review_package_id
                  and decision.member_key = member.member_key
                  and decision.decision = 'approved'
              )
          )
        )
    )
    when 'qc_passed' then exists (
      select 1
      from public.review_packages package
      join public.tasks task on task.id = package.task_id
      where package.id = (
        select current_package.id
        from public.review_packages current_package
        where current_package.episode_id = p_episode_id
          and current_package.stage = 'qc_review'
          and current_package.invalidated_at is null
        order by current_package.revision_number desc, current_package.created_at desc
        limit 1
      )
        and task.episode_id = p_episode_id
        and task.task_type = 'generate_review_render'
        and task.status = 'completed'
        and (
          select count(distinct artifact.artifact_type) = 4
          from public.artifacts artifact
          where artifact.episode_id = p_episode_id
            and artifact.producer_task_id = task.id
            and artifact.artifact_type in (
              'render',
              'review_render_project',
              'review_render_runtime',
              'review_qc_report'
            )
        )
    )
    when 'production_completed' then (
      select count(distinct artifact_type) = 5
        and exists (
          select 1
          from public.tasks verification
          join public.artifacts publish_package
            on publish_package.episode_id = verification.episode_id
           and publish_package.artifact_type = 'publish_package'
          where verification.episode_id = p_episode_id
            and verification.task_type = 'verify_publish_package'
            and verification.status = 'completed'
            and verification.input_snapshot #>> '{publish_package,sha256}' = publish_package.sha256
            and (verification.input_snapshot #>> '{publish_package,file_size}')::bigint = publish_package.file_size
        )
      from public.artifacts
      where episode_id = p_episode_id
        and artifact_type in ('final_render', 'cover', 'metadata', 'final_qc_report', 'publish_package')
    )
    else true
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.retry_failed_final_render(p_episode_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS public.tasks
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  selected_episode public.episodes;
  selected_task public.tasks;
begin
  if btrim(coalesce(p_reason, '')) = '' then
    raise exception 'Retry reason is required' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select episode.* into selected_episode
  from public.episodes episode
  join public.account_memberships membership on membership.account_id = episode.account_id
  where episode.id = p_episode_id
    and membership.user_id = local_identity.owner_id()
    and membership.role = 'owner'
  for update of episode;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Owner membership is required to retry final rendering' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if selected_episode.stage <> 'qc_passed' then
    raise exception 'Only qc-passed episodes can retry final rendering' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select task.* into selected_task
  from public.tasks task
  join public.review_packages package on package.id::text = task.input_snapshot #>> '{final_render,source_review_package_id}'
  join public.approvals approval on approval.review_package_id = package.id and approval.stage = 'qc_passed' and approval.decision = 'approved'
  where task.episode_id = selected_episode.id
    and task.task_type = 'generate_final_render'
    and package.invalidated_at is null
  order by task.created_at desc
  limit 1
  for update of task;
  if not found or selected_task.status <> 'failed' then
    raise exception 'The current final render has not failed' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  update public.tasks
  set status = 'ready',
      max_attempts = selected_task.attempt + 1,
      claimed_at = null,
      completed_at = null
  where id = selected_task.id
  returning * into selected_task;

  insert into public.audit_events (account_id, episode_id, event_type, payload, actor_id)
  values (
    selected_episode.account_id,
    selected_episode.id,
    'final_render_retry_requested',
    jsonb_build_object('task_id', selected_task.id, 'attempt', selected_task.attempt, 'reason', btrim(p_reason)),
    local_identity.owner_id()
  );
  return selected_task;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reuse_shot_preparation_history_after_storyboard_approval()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  package_record public.review_packages;
  episode_record public.episodes;
  shot jsonb;
  previous public.shot_preparation_drafts;
  old_track public.audio_tracks;
  reusable_video boolean;
  reusable_audio boolean;
  new_track public.audio_tracks;
  operation_kind text;
  operation_shot_id text;
  preserve_duration_inputs boolean;
  preserve_type_inputs boolean;
begin
  if new.stage <> 'storyboard_approved' or new.decision <> 'approved' or new.review_package_id is null then return new; end if;

  select episode.* into episode_record from public.episodes episode where episode.id = new.episode_id;
  select package.* into package_record
  from public.review_packages package
  where package.id = new.review_package_id
    and package.episode_id = new.episode_id
    and package.stage = 'storyboard_review'
    and package.invalidated_at is null;
  if not found or episode_record.stage <> 'storyboard_approved' then return new; end if;

  operation_kind := coalesce(package_record.context_snapshot #>> '{storyboard_revision,operation,kind}', '');
  operation_shot_id := nullif(btrim(package_record.context_snapshot #>> '{storyboard_revision,operation,shotId}'), '');

  for shot in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(package_record.context_snapshot #> '{worker_result,storyboard,shots}', '[]'::jsonb)) loop
    preserve_duration_inputs := operation_kind = 'change_duration' and operation_shot_id = shot ->> 'id';
    preserve_type_inputs := operation_kind = 'change_type' and operation_shot_id = shot ->> 'id';

    select draft.* into previous
    from public.shot_preparation_drafts draft
    where draft.episode_id = episode_record.id
      and draft.shot_id = shot ->> 'id'
      and draft.review_package_id <> package_record.id
      and (
        draft.input_fingerprint = md5(shot::text)
        or preserve_duration_inputs
        or preserve_type_inputs
      )
    order by (draft.input_fingerprint = md5(shot::text)) desc, draft.updated_at desc, draft.id desc
    limit 1;
    if not found then continue; end if;

    reusable_video := not preserve_type_inputs
      and previous.current_video_artifact_id is not null
      and previous.current_video_task_id is not null
      and exists (
        select 1
        from public.artifacts artifact
        join public.tasks task on task.id = previous.current_video_task_id
        where artifact.id = previous.current_video_artifact_id
          and artifact.producer_task_id = task.id
          and artifact.episode_id = episode_record.id
          and task.episode_id = episode_record.id
          and task.status = 'completed'
          and task.invalidated_at is null
      );

    select track.* into old_track
    from public.audio_tracks track
    join public.tasks task on task.id = track.source_task_id
    join public.artifacts artifact on artifact.id = track.source_artifact_id
    where (not preserve_type_inputs or previous.audio_mode = 'tts')
      and track.id = previous.current_audio_track_id
      and track.episode_id = episode_record.id
      and track.cue_id = previous.shot_id
      and task.status = 'completed'
      and task.invalidated_at is null
      and artifact.episode_id = episode_record.id
      and artifact.sha256 = track.sha256
      and artifact.file_size = track.file_size;
    reusable_audio := found;

    if reusable_audio then
      insert into public.audio_tracks (episode_id, source_task_id, source_artifact_id, source_review_package_id, track_kind, cue_id, relative_path, sha256, file_size, start_seconds, duration_seconds)
      select episode_record.id, old_track.source_task_id, old_track.source_artifact_id, package_record.id, old_track.track_kind, old_track.cue_id, old_track.relative_path, old_track.sha256, old_track.file_size, old_track.start_seconds, old_track.duration_seconds
      where not exists (
        select 1 from public.audio_tracks existing
        where existing.episode_id = episode_record.id
          and existing.source_review_package_id = package_record.id
          and existing.track_kind = old_track.track_kind
          and existing.cue_id = old_track.cue_id
          and existing.source_task_id = old_track.source_task_id
          and existing.source_artifact_id = old_track.source_artifact_id
      );
      select track.* into new_track
      from public.audio_tracks track
      where track.episode_id = episode_record.id
        and track.source_review_package_id = package_record.id
        and track.source_task_id = old_track.source_task_id
        and track.cue_id = old_track.cue_id
      order by track.created_at desc, track.id desc
      limit 1;
    else
      new_track := null;
    end if;

    update public.shot_preparation_drafts draft
    set audio_mode = previous.audio_mode,
        video_status = case when reusable_video then 'ready' else 'pending' end,
        audio_status = case when previous.audio_mode = 'none' or reusable_audio then 'ready' else 'pending' end,
        confirmation_status = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then 'pending' else previous.confirmation_status end,
        subtitle_text = previous.subtitle_text,
        subtitles_enabled = previous.subtitles_enabled,
        tts_voice = previous.tts_voice,
        tts_speaking_rate = previous.tts_speaking_rate,
        tts_text = previous.tts_text,
        tts_language_code = previous.tts_language_code,
        tts_override_voice = previous.tts_override_voice,
        tts_override_speaking_rate = previous.tts_override_speaking_rate,
        tts_text_confirmation_fingerprint = previous.tts_text_confirmation_fingerprint,
        tts_text_confirmed_at = previous.tts_text_confirmed_at,
        tts_text_confirmed_by = previous.tts_text_confirmed_by,
        selected_material_revision_id = case when preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.selected_material_revision_id end,
        clip_start_seconds = case when preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.clip_start_seconds end,
        clip_end_seconds = case when preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.clip_end_seconds end,
        clip_segments = case when preserve_type_inputs then '[]'::jsonb else previous.clip_segments end,
        video_duration_seconds = case when preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.video_duration_seconds end,
        current_video_artifact_id = case when reusable_video then previous.current_video_artifact_id else null end,
        current_video_task_id = case when reusable_video then previous.current_video_task_id else null end,
        current_audio_track_id = case when new_track.id is not null then new_track.id else null end,
        current_tts_task_id = case when previous.audio_mode = 'tts' and new_track.id is not null then new_track.source_task_id else null end,
        pending_video_task_id = null,
        pending_tts_task_id = null,
        pending_source_audio_task_id = null,
        video_error = null,
        tts_actual_duration_seconds = case when reusable_audio then previous.tts_actual_duration_seconds else null end,
        tts_error = case when reusable_audio then previous.tts_error else null end,
        source_audio_duration_seconds = case when reusable_audio then previous.source_audio_duration_seconds else null end,
        source_audio_error = case when reusable_audio then previous.source_audio_error else null end,
        warning_decision = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then 'not_required' else previous.warning_decision end,
        warning_reason = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.warning_reason end,
        warning_accepted_at = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.warning_accepted_at end,
        warning_accepted_by = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.warning_accepted_by end,
        confirmation_reason = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.confirmation_reason end,
        confirmed_at = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.confirmed_at end,
        confirmed_by = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.confirmed_by end,
        skipped_at = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.skipped_at end,
        skipped_by = case when preserve_duration_inputs or preserve_type_inputs then null else previous.skipped_by end,
        frozen_at = null,
        frozen_by = null,
        updated_at = now()
    where draft.episode_id = episode_record.id
      and draft.review_package_id = package_record.id
      and draft.shot_id = shot ->> 'id';
  end loop;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_shot_transition_mode(p_episode_id uuid, p_review_package_id uuid, p_shot_id text, p_transition_mode text)
 RETURNS public.shot_preparation_drafts
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  draft public.shot_preparation_drafts;
begin
  if p_transition_mode not in ('cut', 'fade', 'studio') then
    raise exception 'Shot transition mode is invalid' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  select target.* into draft
  from public.shot_preparation_drafts target
  join public.episodes episode on episode.id = target.episode_id
  join public.account_memberships membership
    on membership.account_id = episode.account_id and membership.user_id = local_identity.owner_id() and membership.role = 'owner'
  where target.episode_id = p_episode_id
    and target.review_package_id = p_review_package_id
    and target.shot_id = btrim(p_shot_id)
  for update of target;
  if not found then raise exception 'Owner shot workbench access is required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;

  update public.shot_preparation_drafts target
  set transition_mode = p_transition_mode, preparation_contract_status = 'current',
      frozen_at = case when target.transition_mode is distinct from p_transition_mode then null else target.frozen_at end,
      frozen_by = case when target.transition_mode is distinct from p_transition_mode then null else target.frozen_by end,
      updated_at = now()
  where target.id = draft.id
  returning * into draft;
  return draft;
end;
